title: audit-log-exporter: wire Helm + Terraform for Private, add retention and export-sink wiring
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Wire audit-log-exporter into the Private installer (Helm + Terraform) so customers deploying Redwood Private have a supported, auditable export path for platform and API audit logs. This PR adds Helm chart wiring, Terraform module outputs/inputs for retention and export sinks (S3/Syslog/Elastic), installer hooks to create required IAM/policy objects in cloud targets, and upgrade/rollback probes to validate audit pipeline during Private upgrades. Motivation: Compliance teams require reliable, configurable export and retention for audit logs in Private deployments. Previously the audit-log-exporter was available but not wired into the Private installer and Terraform modules; that forced manual changes for deployments which caused configuration drift and incidents (see linked Linear ENG-4421). What this PR does: - Adds a dedicated audit-log-exporter subchart to redwood-private-installer/helm with values to configure retention, export sinks (s3/syslog/elasticsearch), backoff/retry and resource requests. - Exposes Terraform module inputs/outputs so the redwood-private-installer-terraform can provision/consume export sinks and retention policies (S3 lifecycle rules, retention days). - Installer preflight hook ensures that when using cloud-backed sinks, required IAM roles/policies are created or validated; for on-prem mode the chart uses cluster-level ServiceAccount + RBAC. - Adds migration/upgrade checks: post-upgrade job that verifies that the exporter can write to the configured sinks and that retention policies are applied. The job fails the upgrade if critical validation fails, with an explicit rollback path. - Adds unit + e2e tests for Helm values rendering, Terraform plan validation, and a lightweight integration test that runs the exporter against a mocked S3 sink. - Updates redwood-private-installer docs with configuration examples and compliance notes. Checklist: - [x] Helm subchart and values schema - [x] Terraform module inputs/outputs + examples - [x] Installer hook for IAM/policies and RBAC - [x] Upgrade validation job + rollback guidance - [x] Unit tests and CI pipeline integration - [x] Docs and release notes Commits (summary): - add(helm): audit-log-exporter subchart with values and templates - feat(terraform): expose audit_log_exporter sink inputs/outputs, lifecycle rules - infra(installer): installer preflight hook for audit sink IAM/RBAC - test: add helm unit tests and terraform validate step - ci: run e2e integration test with mocked s3 sink - docs: private installer audit-logging configuration and compliance notes Files changed (high-level): - redwood-private-installer/helm/charts/audit-log-exporter/Chart.yaml - redwood-private-installer/helm/charts/audit-log-exporter/values.schema.json - redwood-private-installer/helm/charts/audit-log-exporter/templates/deployment.yaml - redwood-private-installer/helm/charts/audit-log-exporter/templates/configmap.yaml - redwood-private-installer/helm/templates/preflight-audit-hook.yaml - terraform/modules/audit_log_exporter/main.tf - terraform/modules/audit_log_exporter/outputs.tf - terraform/examples/private-with-audit/variables.tf - terraform/examples/private-with-audit/README.md - tests/helm/test_audit_values.py - tests/terraform/test_audit_module_plan.sh - docs/private/audit-logging.md Review conversation (high-level): - Ethan Liu (reviewer): "Overall direction looks good. Please split the IAM policy creation into a separate transactional step in the installer so we don't partially create cloud resources on failed installs. Also add explicit unit tests for the lifecycle rule generation." - Asha Patel (author): "Added installer transactional step (preflight + commit hook) and added unit tests for lifecycle rule generation. See commits 3-4." - Samira Kaur (reviewer): "Can we make retention default conservative (90 days) and expose a clear knob in the values schema? Also need explicit logging for failed export attempts so ops can triage compliance issues." - Asha Patel: "Default retention updated to 90 days, added exporter metrics/logging on sink failure and retries." - Priya Menon (final approver): "Verified terraform plan and helm template renders in CI. e2e failed initially due to a perm issue on the mocked S3 but subsequent fix passed. Approving to merge once CI green." CI summary: - build: pass - unit-tests: pass - lint: pass - terraform-validate: pass - helm-lint: pass - e2e-integration (mock-s3): initially fail (permission on mocked S3), rerun -> pass - security-scan: pass Merge outcome: merged by Priya Menon via squash merge. Merge commit message: "audit-log-exporter: wire Helm + Terraform for Private, add retention + export sinks (ENG-4421)" Release notes: "Private installer: audit-log-exporter is now wired into Helm and Terraform. Administrators can configure export sinks (S3/Syslog/Elastic) and retention policies via installer values and terraform inputs. Upgrade validation will verify sink connectivity; failing checks will trigger a documented rollback path. See docs/private/audit-logging.md for configuration and compliance considerations." Additional notes: - Backwards compatibility: values default preserve existing behavior (export disabled) so this is non-breaking for existing installs. - Rollback guidance added to docs and installer: run preflight-checks, apply new release; if post-upgrade-export-check fails use documented rollback script (installer rollback --target release). - Follow-ups: add an Elastic sink secure connector (ENG-4502) and add long-duration e2e tests for retention lifecycle (ENG-4530).
